data.title: BlackRock Files Its Third Bitcoin ETF, A 'Buffer' Fund That Targets Investors Seeking Downside Protection
data.description: BlackRock’s new proposed “PBIT” fund would use options on IBIT, cash, and short-term bonds rather than directly holding BTC shares.
